paragraphs: Rabbi Yaakov bar Giyori — [Eruvin 62a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.62a.9). In Yuchasin, the form Rabbi Yaakov son of Rav Giyori is copied from [Moed Katan 18a](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.18a.17); Hyman’s Gemara reading, however, is “bar Giyori.”[^1]

notes.text: Eruvin gives Rabbi Yitzchak be-Rabbi Yaakov bar Giyorei; Moed Katan gives Rav Yitzchak bar Yaakov bar Giyorei. In both, Yitzchak sends a teaching in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. [Heilprin’s entry for Yaakov](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2107&lang=en) distinguishes his notices from those of [Yitzchak](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2170&lang=en).
